_comment: A pinned, unmodified copy of Learn's tutorial 'Review access to administrative roles using access reviews APIs', as its Learn source page: the sample requests for an access review of a privileged role exist only inside this page. Never edit these files: update the snapshot by copying a newer upstream commit and regenerating this manifest in a reviewed pull request. scripts/tests/test_third_party_snapshots.py fails when a file stops matching its hash.
name: Learn sample: access review of administrative roles (Microsoft Graph access reviews API tutorial)
license: Documentation: CC BY 4.0 (LICENSE). Code: MIT (LICENSE-CODE). Both copied from the repository root.
not_copied: Everything else in microsoftgraph/microsoft-graph-docs-contrib, including the SDK snippet includes the page's language tabs pull in (includes/snippets/*): the HTTP requests are the sample, and they are inside this one page, so the page is pinned whole; the chapter links Learn rather than quoting it.
